import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive insights
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival rate by class and gender
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_class_sex = df.groupby(['class', 'sex'])['survived'].mean().unstack()
survival_class_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], alpha=0.8)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Gender', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax1.set_xticklabels(ax1.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45)
ax1.legend(title='Gender', loc='upper right')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age distribution by survival
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survived_ages = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
died_ages = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()
ax2.hist([died_ages, survived_ages], bins=20, label=['Died', 'Survived'], 
         color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age (years)')
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Passengers')
ax2.legend(loc='upper right')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Survival rate by embarked port
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
embark_survival = df.groupby('embarked')['survived'].agg(['sum', 'count'])
embark_survival['rate'] = embark_survival['sum'] / embark_survival['count']
embark_labels = {'S': 'Southampton', 'C': 'Cherbourg', 'Q': 'Queenstown'}
embark_survival.index = embark_survival.index.map(lambda x: embark_labels.get(x, x))
bars = ax3.bar(embark_survival.index, embark_survival['rate'], 
               color=['#95E1D3', '#F38181', '#AA96DA'], alpha=0.8, edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Port of Embarkation')
ax3.set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
for i, bar in enumerate(bars):
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
             f'{height:.2%}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontweight='bold')

# 4. Fare distribution by class and survival
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):
    survived_fare = df[(df['pclass'] == pclass) & (df['survived'] == 1)]['fare']
    died_fare = df[(df['pclass'] == pclass) & (df['survived'] == 0)]['fare']
    
violin_data = []
labels = []
positions = []
pos = 0
colors = []
for pclass in sorted(df['pclass'].unique()):
    for survived, label_suffix in [(0, ' Died'), (1, ' Survived')]:
        data = df[(df['pclass'] == pclass) & (df['survived'] == survived)]['fare'].dropna()
        if len(data) > 0:
            violin_data.append(data)
            labels.append(f'Class {pclass}{label_suffix}')
            positions.append(pos)
            colors.append('#FF6B6B' if survived == 0 else '#4ECDC4')
            pos += 1
    pos += 0.5

parts = ax4.violinplot(violin_data, positions=positions, widths=0.7, showmeans=True)
for i, pc in enumerate(parts['bodies']):
    pc.set_facecolor(colors[i])
    pc.set_alpha(0.7)
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Class and Survival', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class and Survival Status')
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare (£)')
ax4.set_xticks(positions)
ax4.set_xticklabels(labels, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Create custom legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [Patch(facecolor='#FF6B6B', alpha=0.7, label='Died'),
                   Patch(facecolor='#4ECDC4', alpha=0.7, label='Survived')]
ax4.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
